seed: The seventh guide of the Icons track: when a motion happens and how long it takes. It opens on a bell whose body already swings, because a guide about tuning a motion should not spend a third of itself making one, and the sample arrives PLAYING so its first card is true before anybody presses anything. The walk types a shorter Over, picks a different curve from the list that draws every shape beside its name, and types a Start, which is the number the guide after this one drags on a ruler instead.

steps.note: THE TEST for the opening card: the sample arrives moving, so 'this one already swings' is true on sight rather than after a press nobody was told about.
the swing as one row, read back as a sentence: what it goes from, what it goes to, and how long that takes. Under it are the five things that decide how it plays.
Over is how long the change takes, and the summary says the new number back. Under about 200ms the swing stops reading as a swing and starts reading as a twitch, which is why the guide names a floor.
THE TEST: every curve has its SHAPE drawn beside its name, because nobody can tell ease out back from ease out quint by reading them.

THE TEST the acceptance asks for: timing is something you SET, not something that just happens. Start is how long the bell holds still at the top of every lap before it goes, and the row says it in words.
and what happens once it has played. There and back goes out and comes home inside one lap, which is what an icon nearly always wants: a loop that does not come home is a jump cut.
